row.title: CONNECT-ONCE-1: sign-ins now last, with the causes read from the credential log
row.body: Read from credential_events on 2026-11-20: Bluesky renewals carried no DPoP proof (HTTP 401 on 339 ticks) and the public client has a 2 week session cap in the atproto spec; Mastodon tokens with no expiry were marked failed on 369 ticks; the GitHub connect link registered a new App on each visit. seed/worker/src/auth now signs renewals, uses a confidential client with a sealed key, leaves a token with no expiry alone and answers a working connection as connected. Verified by seed/worker/test/social-connect.test.js. Residual risk: Bluesky's real server has not yet accepted the new client, which is known only after the next sign-in; posting stays dry-run until then.
